Enabled.Name: Enable images
Enabled.Hint: When disabled, no one sees the images.

Audience.Name: Whose messages to change
Audience.Hint: By default only messages sent by players (not the GM).
Audience.PlayerActors: Messages of player-owned actors (even if rolled by GM)

CritOverride.Name: Crits override category
CritOverride.Hint: Natural 20 or 1 on a d20 (attack, skill, save) shows the critical success or failure image instead. Take 10/20 does not count.

Size.Name: Maximum size, px
Size.Hint: The image fits into a square of this size, keeping proportions.

Settings.ImageHint: Leave empty to show no image for this category.

Chance.Name: Show chance, %
Chance.Hint: Probability that an image appears for an action. Everyone sees the same result.

CritAlways.Name: Always show crits
CritAlways.Hint: Critical success and failure images appear on every crit, ignoring the chance.

Opacity.Name: Opacity
Opacity.Hint: 1 is fully opaque, lower values are see-through.

Fade.Name: Edge gradient width, %
Fade.Hint: How softly the image edges fade into the background. 0 means hard edges.

Duration.Name: Display time, seconds
Duration.Hint: Time before the image starts fading out.

ShowForMe.Name: Show to me
ShowForMe.Hint: Personal setting: turn the images off just for yourself.
